definitions.name: Angle

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: White wire analog output is specified as 0..2500mV. Official AngleUnit uses the host ADC with 11dB attenuation; read_u16 is host ADC scaling rather than an I2C value.
gaps: Mechanical angle-to-voltage transfer and SoC-specific ADC conversion/attenuation need a controller model.

claims: guest driver transaction path and encoding
